message:
Last week, I had a little scare when my granddaughter came to me in a panic because her favorite stuffed animal was missing. In the midst of our search, I remembered the go-bag I’d put together a while back. Inside, I found a small flashlight, which I used to check under the couch. To our delight, there it was, gleaming in the light! 

It reminded me how those small preparations can really save the day, even in unexpected ways. Have you ever had a moment like that?
